- **Starting state matches:** the store repository is at `aa7a6ef27333fba8377e3ee06ee43024e24ce3c0`, and `git status --short --untracked-files=all` shows no changes.
- **No changes, as planned (D-29z778):** I didn't edit any file in `store/` and didn't touch the protected files.
- **Checks:** I ran no tests, typecheck, lint, code review or browser checks, because the task says not to when nothing changed. I left the server on 127.0.0.1:5173 alone.
- **Report:** `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-301.md` records the starting state and the checks C should run next. C first confirms at start and end that the code hasn't changed (the `sha256sum -c b-round-300-r301-tree-sha256.txt` check should show 0 failures), then runs the regression checks in sections 3–5 of the task. Since I wrote nothing, any difference C finds came from someone else.

The only acceptance item I marked passed is the starting-state check. I haven't marked anything in the backlog as complete.
